_README: Editable inputs for landed_cost.py. null = not set: counted as 0 in the math AND listed in missing_inputs. Set DEAL_HUNTER_COST_CONFIG=/path/to/file.json to run with a different config (isolated test mode) without touching this one. Customer shipping, postage and packaging are independent blocks under resale.

fx._note: Set JPY to USD per 1 yen (for example 0.0065). buffer_pct widens the cost to cover rate drift and your card/PayPal conversion spread.

discogs._notes: Payment rate: PayPal US standard commercial rate per paypal.com/us/business/paypal-business-fees (page dated Oct 1 2026). Discogs fee: Discogs' own fees page says 8%, but its PayPal FAQ and third-party sources say 9%, and the base (item vs item+shipping) is not stated on the official fees page. Marketplace fee and processing are SEPARATE charges; each is applied once. Confirm 9% and the base in your Discogs seller dashboard.

customer_shipping._note: What the BUYER pays you: $7.99 covers up to 3 records, +$0.50 per additional record.

postage._note: YOUR actual postage (media mail ~2 lb). Per-additional is unset: only flagged when an order has more than 3 records.

packaging._note: Box + packing material per order (bought-box price).

decision_safety._notes: Report-only by default: every deal gets buy_now_blockers / buy_now_gate_pass but decisions change only when enforce_buy_now_gate is true.
